title: FLSclaw fork feature registry entry
description: Strict config schema for scripts/sweep/inventory/*.yaml. The inventory is configuration only: owner-authored declarations of topology, ownership and driver levers, tracked in the fork repo and never written by the driver. It carries no prose addressed to the agent and no record of a decision: a decision lives in the code it produced, or on the pull request that made it. An entry with a `branch` is swept; one without is planned. The runtime authority is parseFeatureEntry (registry.ts); keep both in sync.

branch.description: Owning branch (canonical authoring home). Present = the entry is swept; absent = planned/observational.

parents.description: DAG edges: the branches this one stacks on (child <- parents).

dependents.description: Branches stacked on this one (blast radius of a bad merge).

owned_paths.description: Gitignore-style globs whose canonical home is `branch`. Derived from branch-vs-parent ADDITIONS, never symmetric diff (see README).

key_symbols.description: "Symbol — file" strings naming the feature's API.

test_anchors.description: Test files (on the owning branch) proving the feature works.

scope_guard.description: Per-feature scope-guard override (§7 lever); beats the global default.

tier_floor.description: Floors every merge of this branch at JUDGED (MERGE-POLICY §1).

always_merge.description: Forces an (empty) merge even when parents no-op (leaf rule).
